verses.text: The word of YHWH that came to Jeremiah concerning the droughts:

segments.text: The word of YHWH that came to Jeremiah concerning the droughts:

verses.text: “Judah mourns, and her gates languish; they mourn for the land, and the cry of Jerusalem has gone up.

segments.text: “Judah mourns, and her gates languish; they mourn for the land, and the cry of Jerusalem has gone up.

verses.text: And their nobles have sent their young for water; they went to the cisterns, they did not find water. They returned with their vessels empty; they were ashamed and humiliated, and they covered their heads.

verses.text: Because the ground is parched, for there was no rain in the land, the plowmen were ashamed; they covered their heads.

verses.text: Indeed, even the doe in the field has brought forth—to forsake [it] because there is no grass.

verses.text: And the wild donkeys stand on the barren heights; they pant for the wind like jackals, and their eyes fail because [there is] no grass.”

verses.text: Though our iniquities testify against us, O YHWH, may You act for the sake of Your name! For many are our backslidings; we have sinned against You.

segments.text: Though our iniquities testify against us, O YHWH, may You act for the sake of Your name! For many are our backslidings; we have sinned against You.

verses.text: O Hope of Israel, his Savior in time of distress, why should You be like a sojourner in the land, and like a traveler [who] stretches aside to spend the night.

segments.text: O Hope of Israel, his Savior in time of distress, why should You be like a sojourner in the land, and like a traveler [who] stretches aside to spend the night.

verses.text: Why should You be like a man astonished, like a mighty one not able to save? And You [are] among us, O YHWH, and we are called [by] Your name; do not leave us.

segments.text: Why should You be like a man astonished, like a mighty one not able to save? And You [are] among us, O YHWH, and we are called [by] Your name; do not leave us.

verses.text: Thus says YHWH to this people: “Thus have they loved to wander, they have not held back their feet, and YHWH has not accepted them; now He will remember their iniquity and punish them for their sins.”

verses.text: And YHWH said to me: “Do not pray for this people for the good.

segments.text: And YHWH said to me: “Do not pray for this people for the good.

verses.text: When they fast, I will not hear to their cry; and when they bring up a burnt offering and grain offering, I will not accept them—but by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence I will put an end to them!

segments.text: When they fast, I will not hear to their cry; and when they bring up a burnt offering and grain offering, I will not accept them—but by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence I will put an end to them!

verses.text: And I said “Ah, Lord YHWH!” Behold, the prophets are saying to them, ‘You⁺ will not see the sword, and there shall be no famine for you⁺; but I will give to you⁺ assured peace in this place.’”

verses.text: And YHWH said to me: “The prophets are prophesying lies in My name.” I have not sent them, and I have not commanded them, and not I have spoken to them. They are prophesying to you⁺ a false vision and divination, and worthlessness, and the deceit of their heart.

verses.text: Therefore, thus says YHWH concerning the prophets who prophesy in My name, “When I did not send them, and they say, ‘Sword and famine will not be in this land.’ By sword and by famine those prophets will meet their end!

verses.text: And the people whom they prophesy to them will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword, and no one will bury them—they [and] their wives, and their sons, and their daughters; and I will pour their wickedness on them.

segments.text: And the people whom they prophesy to them will be thrown out into the streets of Jerusalem because of the famine and the sword, and no one will bury them—they [and] their wives, and their sons, and their daughters; and I will pour their wickedness on them.

verses.text: And you shall speak to them this word: ‘Let my eyes run down with tears night and day, and do not let them cease! For the virgin daughter of my people has been wounded with a mighty breach, with a serious blow.

verses.text: If I go out [to] the field, and behold—those slain by the sword! And if I come [into] the city, and behold—those sick from famine! How both prophet and priest go about in the land, and they do not know!’”

verses.text: Have you completely rejected Judah? Or has Your soul abhorred Zion? Why did You strike us and [there is] no healing for us? We looked for peace, and [there was] no good; and for the time of healing, and there was terror!

verses.text: We acknowledge, O YHWH, our wickedness, [and] the iniquity of our fathers; for we have sinned against You.

verses.text: For the sake of Your name do not spurn [us], do not disgrace the throne of Your glory! Remember, do not break Your covenant with us.

verses.text: Are there any among the idols of the nations able to bring rain? Or can the heavens give showers? [Are] You not He, O YHWH our God? And we shall wait for You, since You make all these [things].
